name: container_sync
about: One container-sync set on two workers that run their own Docker daemon: a consumer app on r1w-02 and a provider app on r1w-01, both created through the Deeploy API. The provider publishes two archives of its fixed-size volume 90 s apart (more than the consumer's 60 s chain-store refresh, so each archive is applied on its own); the check passes when the chain-store record on the oracles points at the latest archive, the consumer applied every archive (or a later one) within 150 s of its publish, no record was refused, and the file the provider wrote reads the same inside the consumer app. Needs init --docker-nodes r1w-01,r1w-02 and the image redis:7-alpine on this machine (any BusyBox image works: change image).
